doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: First job with Kid Thomas and other names
summary: His first job was with Kid Thomas, with whom he has played about 39 years; he mentions Fletcher Henderson, Red Allen and his nicknames.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Who was your first job with?
My first job was with Thomas, Kid Thomas.
That's my first job. He's a famous band. He's been playing about, I guess, about 50 years. I've been playing with him about 39 years myself.

Yeah, I'll be 62 years old, I think, this Christmas. Not I think, I better be sure. Not 62, 57. 57. 57. I take that back, because I ain't ashamed to tell my age. And many bands on the road. Duke, Fletcher Henderson. I have played bass with him when the first thing they put the hatchet on the band. Red Allen time, he was playing with him in that time. Which him and I raised up together. Down on Verrett Street. Yeah, right across from the graveyard. He may yell this and he know this old twat talking. Well, in them time they called me Toik. Cherrick, huh?
Uh-huh. And then I had another name before then. I used to be a style composer. I was very... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
